summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a $1.5M term loan from ACH Capital West, LLC. The loan features weekly payments of $43,437.50, interest of $585,000, maturity May 11, 2027, and a $45,000 origination fee. Nuvve granted a continuing security interest in receivables and personal property. Early repayment discounts range from $210,000 to $120,000 within 120 days. Default triggers a 25% penalty. This is a standard debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. No change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic event is implicated.
